name: Haresu
source: Haresu works as a servant at Mr. [url=https://vndb.org/c61003]Maxim[/url]'s mansion together with [url=https://vndb.org/c30063]Riru[/url]. He is a rather timid guy who has fears of authority figures but despite his flaws he will try his best to save people he holds dear to himself. Little does he know that his life is about to change in a very dramatic way after Lieutenant [url=https://vndb.org/c29770]Prosper[/url]'s military unit stations themselves at Mr. Maxim's villa.
